### LOW: Changelog describes publishing short repeated prefixes to the SSD cache, outside the T\-041 per\-donation gate
[CHANGELOG\.md:8](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/c24c4ed4c5d7c0c3e1779227167103ab63e09b49/CHANGELOG.md#L8) · T-041

The changelog says an aligned demanded boundary is now captured "below the normal solo stripe, so repeated short prefixes can be published for reuse"\. It also says repeated checkpoints get the reserved SSD write share on first local appearance\. T\-041 records the encrypted SSD tier as signed off only for donations whose whole\-block prefix exceeds the model's adoption bound plus the 1,024\-token benefit floor\. T\-041's detection\_hint says loosening that gate widens the at\-rest surface and needs a fresh SEC\-035 review\. If this code lets sub\-threshold prefixes reach SSDPrefixCache\.donate, more at\-rest artifacts are written and the same\-account TTFT oracle extends to short prefixes\. Only the changelog was supplied, so the actual gate behaviour is unverified\. Fix: confirm that the SSD donation guard still applies to demanded short captures, or document the exception and refresh the T\-041/SEC\-035 sign\-off\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5

### LOW: New public model\-demand statistics disclosure surface is not covered by the threat model
[CHANGELOG\.md:608](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/c24c4ed4c5d7c0c3e1779227167103ab63e09b49/CHANGELOG.md#L608) · T-051

CHANGELOG\.md line 608 describes publishing per\-model hourly request and fulfillment aggregates on the Stats page, with CSV export and 24h, 7d and 30d histories\. The listed controls are a one\-hour publication delay, suppression of cohorts with fewer than 20 requests or 3 consumer accounts, and exclusion of suppressed hours from every resolution\. The base threat model has no entry for public aggregate leakage of consumer activity\. T\-051 covers only profiler tables and admin exports\. Risks to model: a consumer or competitor could use small cohorts, hour\-boundary differencing between resolutions, or sybil accounts to infer or influence demand\. Public outcome counts for capacity, timeout and error could also reveal fleet weaknesses\. Fix: add a threat entry and assumptions for the public stats boundary, and verify the suppression and differencing logic in the code\. This unit shows only the changelog text, so the implementation is not verified\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5
